messages:
Maria: Heads-up — I'm seeing ~20% of HubSpot leads not get an owner within our 5m SLA after enrichment finishes. Repro window: 2024-06-12 09:00-11:00 UTC. Anyone else noticing this?
Dan: Yep, saw a spike yesterday morning. Mostly webhooks + some API imports.
Maria: Quick paste from the workflow history that looks suspicious:
```
workflow: Assign - inbound
enrollment: 1729001284
status: enrichment_completed
action: assign_owner -> queued (0ms)
claim_service: timeout waiting for rotation (30s) -> deferred
result: enrolled but unassigned after 300000ms SLA
```
Lee: @Maria thanks for the log. Two likely vectors: enrichment latency pushing assignment after claim window OR race in RR allocator when multiple workflows try to claim same bucket.
Lee: Immediate mitigation I suggest: extend claim timeout to 90s and add small jitter (0-1.5s) in the round-robin lease to reduce collisions. Also add a heartbeat that re-enqueues if not assigned in 45s.
Jake: Heads up that some enrichment vendors return ~60-120s during peak, so 90s might still be tight but better. Timezone owners can also miss assignments if owner pool is small (night shift).
Dan: Is the problem mainly in the HS -> SF handoff mapping step? If mapping fails, owner stays null. Any errors in the mapping webhook?
Maria: I checked the mapping logs — no errors surfaced, it's the allocator. The mapping step runs after assignment. So unassigned leads skip SF mapping.
HubSpotBot: Workflow "Assign - inbound" ran for 124 enrollments in the window. 23 enrollments flagged: delayed_assignment=true. (automation id: wf-assign-01)
Lee: Ops patch proposal (temporary):
1) change claim_timeout from 30 -> 90s for workflow wf-assign-01
2) add lease_jitter_ms: random(0,1500) in RR allocator config
3) add requeue_after_ms: 45000 that increments retry_count
4) add a quick metric: hs.assign.delay > 30s -> alert P3 to #marketing
(We can roll back in 24h if no regression)
Dan: +1 to metrics. Can we emit tag "enrichment_delay" when the enrichment step added >20s? Helps triage vendor issues.
Jake: Also request: when owner pool is <3 active reps, fallback to overflow pool to avoid timezone starvation.
Maria: Sounds reasonable. I can own the runbook updates and the postmortem if we still see >5% failure after the patch.
Lee: I'll open a quick PR for the allocator and cut a canary deploy to dedicated infra tonight at 00:30 UTC. Will ping here when done.
HubSpotBot: Automation update: workflow wf-assign-01 updated (claim_timeout=90s, lease_jitter=1500ms) by Lee at 1729005000.
Maria: Thanks @Lee. Post-deploy checklist: monitor hs.assign.delay, assignment_success_rate, and sf.mapping_success for 6h. I'll set a dashboard and a short-lived alert.
Dan: If we still see >8% unassigned after 6h, escalate to vendor for enrichment SLA review.
Jake: I'll draft the overflow pool rules and owner-cooldown exemption so we don't hot-swap owners too frequently.
Maria: Action items: Maria -> dashboard + playbook, Lee -> PR + canary, Jake -> overflow rules, Dan -> alert/resolution policy. Re-check in 6h or earlier if alerts fire. :thumbsup:
